agenda_briefs.title: Council to hear staff report on proposed 2027–2031 Utilities Budget
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council will receive a verbal report and staff presentation on the proposed 2027–2031 Utilities Budget from Richard Rowley, Director of Finance Revenue Services. The presentation is for information only at this stage — no vote or approval is scheduled in this item. The utilities budget covers water, sewer and other utility services, and the rates set through it can affect what businesses pay on their utility bills. Watch for the staff presentation and any later report or bylaw that would set the actual rates.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Watch for the staff presentation and any follow-up report or bylaw that sets utility rates — these can change your business's utility costs.

agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider closed-door talks on land purchase and city service deal
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to meet in a closed session, with the public shut out, to discuss two items: buying, selling or taking over land or buildings, and early-stage talks about a proposed city service. Council says talking about these in public could harm the city's interests. No details are public, and no decision has been made. A closed session means the public and media cannot attend. The land item could affect nearby property owners or businesses if a purchase or expropriation (the city taking private land) moves ahead. The service item is at a preliminary stage, so what it covers is not yet known.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Watch for any follow-up public report or bylaw from this closed session that could affect your property or business.
